message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate criminal charges based on Chinese criminal law. Facts: The defendant Wang (male) and his wife Shi (female) went to police station, tore up a statement (inquiry record) made by Shi, then resisted police, causing injury to police officer Gao (right hand abrasions, rib fracture, light injury). The police tried to detain him, he resisted, shouted, tried to escape. The police officer got injured. The victim (police) got light injury. The defendant has obtained victim's forgiveness (civil settlement). So criminal charges: resisting and assaulting a police officer (妨害公务? or 抗拒执行职务? Let's see Chinese law: Article 277 of Criminal Law: "妨害公务罪" (Obstructing public duties) includes resisting, assaulting, threatening police officers performing duties, causing injury. Also there is "故意伤害罪" (intentional injury) but the injury was caused during resistance; the main charge is "妨害公务罪". Also "毁灭、伪造、变造国家机关证件、印章" not relevant. "非法持有枪支" not. "过失以危险方法危害公共安全" not. "抢劫" not. So likely charge: 妨害公务 (obstructing public duty). Possibly also "故意毁坏公文、证件" because they destroyed the inquiry record (a police document). However the record is a police document; destroying it may be "毁灭、伪造、变造国家机关公文、证件、印章" but that charge is for forging or selling state documents. Destroying a police record may be "破坏国家机关公文、证件、印章" which is also covered under Article 280: "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章罪". But destroying is not forging or selling. There's also "非法侵入国家机关" maybe not. The main is "妨害公务罪". Also "故意伤害罪" could be considered because he caused injury to police. However the injury was incidental to resisting; the law may treat it as part of obstruction. Article 277: If the obstruction causes serious injury, the penalty is higher. Here injury is light. So charge: 妨害公务罪.

Thus answer: [罪名]妨害公务<eoa>. JSON format: {"reasoning":"...","final_answer":"[罪名]妨害公务<eoa>"}
